teaching_method.method: Begin from beginner foundations. Teach the meaning of basic vocabulary first; teach one high-frequency phrase pattern at a time using very simple sentences; start with recognition and substitution before asking for independent sentence construction. Explain everyday meaning before introducing any technical grammar term and never assume a taught word is already mastered.
teaching_method.grammar_terms: Avoid unexplained technical grammar terms; when necessary give plain Chinese explanation with concrete examples before labels.
teaching_method.sentence_production: Start with one-word responses, recognition or one-word replacement; build to short sentences only when learner demonstrates readiness.
teaching_method.reassessment: Do not infer strong foundations from an isolated correct sentence; check understanding and retention over time.

preferences.voice_turn_taking: Allow the learner to pause and think; do not interrupt or treat a brief gap as the end of their answer.
preferences.learner_self_report: Foundational English vocabulary and grammar are weak; needs beginner-paced, vocabulary-first teaching, no assumed sentence-building ability.
